Subject: Request to split committed capacity / redline path

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned on moving to Redwood for inference, but we have an ask on the order form. We want to reallocate 30% of our committed GPU hours from Project Orion to a new pilot (Project Meridian) across Q3.

Can Redwood support a rolling split (no net increase in committed spend) and provide an addendum that:
- updates Exhibit A to reflect the split schedule,
- clarifies spike/burst rules between projects, and
- confirms billing attribution for the two project IDs.

We also need this routed through our procurement/legal review this week. Please send a redline of the MSA + updated Order Form so our counsel can review.

Attachments: capacity-swap_request.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Emma Clark
Head of Cloud Procurement
Crestview Health

- We'll keep the committed unit price the same. We'll allocate existing commits to two line items (Orion / Meridian) based on the split table.

Team — see inline notes in the attached redline. High-level legal points to resolve before we send to Crestview counsel: 

1) Billing attribution: replace vague "project" language with defined term ("Project ID") and add a short definition in Section 1.2.
2) Spike/burst transfers: limit automatic transfer to 24 hours with explicit approvals captured by email or API call. Add sentence to Exhibit A and a small change to the Invoicing section to reflect audit trail requirements.
3) Liability cap: if we introduce separate line items, ensure the MSA cap still applies to aggregate spend across all line items for a rolling period (we should add a parenthetical to the cap clause).

I attached msa_addendum_redline_v1.docx — it's got tracked changes and comments where I need policy/legal input from Crestview (e.g., required logging retention). Also flagged two places where Crestview may push to remove "aggregate" language; be prepared to discuss.

If everyone signs off on these edits I can finalize and we can send to Emma's counsel. Karthik — please confirm the orderform workbook matches the line numbers in the redline.

-Markus

- What we did: converted the single commit into two line items (Orion / Meridian) with identical unit pricing; added Exhibit A schedule for phased split (weeks 1–4: 10/20/70, then stable split 30/70). Added language for 24-hour burst transfer and logging requirements.
- Legal asks for Crestview counsel: please review the added definition for "Project ID" (Section 1.2), confirm acceptable retention window for logs (we propose 90 days), and let us know if the parenthetical on aggregate liability cap requires different wording for your finance team.
